author: deustp01
body: Coming in from outside, does GO:0006002 | fructose 6-phosphate metabolic process truly point to a distinct biological process, or only to one or a few reactions that are a feature of many processes?

author: ValWood
body: It seems to be a mixed bag and not a specific process. But rather than address here, I can add to my list of "possible intermediates or "not a useful grouping term" @pgaudet your decision. The problem for me is that it makes genes like fbp1 fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase Fbp1 require multiple concurrent annotations. i.e This is something that came up multiple times at the GO meeting as something we are aiming to avoid. Here I would annotate as gluconeogenesis part_of cellular response to glucose starvation The rest don't add anything?

author: pgaudet
body:
@ValWood 
> gluconeogenesis part_of cellular response to glucose starvation
The rest don't add anything?

I agree. In particular the 'metabolic process' often just represent a MF (any reaction involving x...')
